name: Rustmaul Dig Site
summary: Silithid swarm over Rustmaul Dig Site, a ruined camp in the southern Shimmering Flats. The Ironforge Explorers' League dug here for ancient ruins until Moktar Krin's Horde war party slaughtered the miners and a swarm rose from below. No mortals remain.

sections.title: A Slaughter in the Salt
sections.body: Ironforge's Explorers' League sent prospectors to Rustmaul Dig Site, seeking forgotten artifacts beneath the salt flats. Their work ended when Moktar Krin led a fierce Horde war party against the camp and killed the dwarven excavators. Yet the attackers found no lasting victory. Their clash apparently disturbed a dormant cave network below, and silithid poured out. The battered survivors could not hold against the swarm and fled.

sections.title: The Awakening Swarm
sections.body: Silithid now overrun Rustmaul, leaving the surface races with no hold there. Alien carapaces and skittering mandibles cover the mining gear and scaffolds. Frightened by the unceasing tide of insects from below, the survivors of Moktar Krin's war party fled north to Ironstone Camp.

faq.q: What is the Rustmaul Dig Site?
faq.answer: Rustmaul Dig Site lies in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dwarven explorers founded the camp to uncover ancient ruins, but silithid swarms have overrun it.

faq.q: Who used to live and work here?
faq.answer: Prospectors and excavators from the dwarven Explorers' League worked at the dig. They sought artifacts and ruins beneath the salt flats.

faq.q: Why is the dig site abandoned and full of bugs?
aliases: why are there bugs at rustmaul
faq.answer: Moktar Krin led a Horde war party that attacked and slaughtered the dwarves. The clash apparently disturbed a subterranean silithid nest in the mine cave, and the swarm drove the surviving attackers away.

faq.q: Where did the surviving attackers go?
faq.answer: The battered survivors of Moktar Krin's Horde war party fled north across the flats to Ironstone Camp. Messengers carried warnings as far as Orgrimmar.

angles.text: Rustmaul is a grim reminder of the dangers facing the Explorers' League. Its scholars were slaughtered here before monstrous insects burst from the earth.
Moktar Krin's war party defeated the dwarven excavators, but silithid emerged after the battle. Their creeping menace now threatens the entire region.
